scoring_justification: Recomputing ICOHP from DFT/COHP raw output is not possible in the verifier; therefore agent-reported ICOHP values are compared to paper gold within tolerance ±0.15 eV and ordering is checked. This is a legitimate T0 fallback.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference ICOHP values from paper Table 3
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 3: B–Ir: −2.06, Zr–Ir: −0.99, Ir–Ir (empty Ir6): −0.74, Ir–Ir (BIr6): −0.37 eV/bond
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are unambiguously given in the paper; used solely for comparison.

B_Ir_ICOHP.description: ICOHP for B–Ir bond (eV per bond, negative for bonding)

Zr_Ir_ICOHP.description: ICOHP for Zr–Ir bond (eV per bond, negative for bonding)

Ir_Ir_empty_ICOHP.description: ICOHP for Ir–Ir contact in empty Ir6 cluster (eV per bond, negative for bonding)

Ir_Ir_filled_ICOHP.description: ICOHP for Ir–Ir contact in BIr6 octahedron (eV per bond, negative for bonding)

outputs.description: Computed integrated crystal orbital Hamilton population (ICOHP) values for the four distinct interatomic contacts in Zr2Ir6B. All values are in eV per bond with negative sign indicating bonding.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker compares the computed ICOHP values to reference values from the paper's Table 3 with an absolute tolerance that absorbs method-dependent spread. The full DFT+COHP pipeline must be executed to obtain correct results.
